plan.question: What has been said about trial by jury since 2020?

sources.title: Hilary Benn, House of Commons, 4 March 2021
Kenneth Clarke, House of Commons, 4 March 2021

answer.markdown: Hilary Benn said that trial by jury was "a cornerstone". In the debate that followed: Kenneth Clarke said jury trial would be kept for serious offences. This was a turning point for every member in the Chamber.

cited.text: The right to trial by jury is a cornerstone of our liberties

segments.text: Hilary Benn said that trial by jury was "a cornerstone".
In the debate that followed:

cited.text: We will keep jury trial for serious offences

segments.text: Kenneth Clarke said jury trial would be kept for serious offences.
This was a turning point for every member in the Chamber.

items.connection: The gift is from the barristers' professional body and the speech is on jury trial.

items.summary: Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State, Ministry of Justice
